_comment: Generated by scripts/sync_catalog.py from Data.gov DCAT records. Do not edit by hand.

ssa-alj-disposition-data.title: ALJ Disposition Data - Current Report
ssa-alj-disposition-data.description: A listing of hearings completion data by name of individual administrative law judges (ALJ) for all ALJs in the Office of Hearings Operations (OHO). The data includes hearing office name, total dispositions, decisions, allowances, denials, and fully favorable or partially favorable decisions.

ssa-dds-accuracy.title: Disability Determination Services (DDS) Accuracy
ssa-dds-accuracy.description: This dataset provides accuracy rate figures for SSA disability medical determinations made by the state DDSs.

ssa-di-annual-statistical-report.title: Annual Statistical Report on the Social Security Disability Insurance Program
ssa-di-annual-statistical-report.description: An annual report providing program and demographic statistics about the people who receive Social Security disability benefits—disabled workers, disabled widow(er)s, and disabled adult children.

ssa-di-ssi-participants-employment-2015.title: DI & SSI Program Participants: Characteristics & Employment, 2015
ssa-di-ssi-participants-employment-2015.description: This chartbook examines the work activity of working-age adult Social Security Disability Insurance (DI) beneficiaries and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) recipients before and after disability award. It covers work activity, employment expectations and characteristics, employment services, and factors affecting employment.

ssa-disability-claim-data.title: SSA Disability Claim Data
ssa-disability-claim-data.description: The dataset includes fiscal year data for initial claims for SSA disability benefits that were referred to a state agency for a disability determination. Specific data elements for each year and state include receipts, determinations, eligible population, and favorable determination rates.

ssa-field-office-appointments-21-days.title: Percentage of Field Office Claims Appointments Scheduled Within 21 Days - FY 2005-2015
ssa-field-office-appointments-21-days.description: The monthly percentage of field office claims appointments scheduled within 21 days. The agency Public Service Indicator is actually "within 28 days".

ssa-field-office-claims-pending.title: Field Office Claims Pending
ssa-field-office-claims-pending.description: This dataset provides field office claims pending counts by year at the national level for federal fiscal years 2006-2022. The count includes all claims pending (in process and not yet adjudicated) in the field offices. "Claims" include applications for Retirement and Survivor Insurance (RSI), RSI Dependent, Disability Insurance (DI), DI Dependent, Supplemental Security Income (SSI) Aged, and SSI Blind/Disabled.

ssa-field-office-employee-counts-2016.title: 2016 Field Office Employee Counts
ssa-field-office-employee-counts-2016.description: This file contains the number of employees in the Social Security Administration field offices for FY 2016.

ssa-field-office-locator.title: Field Office Contact Information
ssa-field-office-locator.description: SSA provides a web service and downloadable file for SSA Field Office locations, telephone numbers, and hours of operation. (Note: If you think an office might be closed due to an emergency, check www.ssa.gov/agency/emergency)

ssa-field-office-telephone-service.title: Field Office Telephone Service - Monthly National Answer Rate and Busy Rate
ssa-field-office-telephone-service.description: This dataset provides information at the national level by month for federal fiscal years 2013 on for answer rate and busy rate for calls to our field offices. The data does not include calls that were abandoned while waiting in queue without representative service or overflow calls, which are those callers who wait in queue over the 15-minute maximum wait time without representative service.

ssa-field-office-visitor-counts-2016.title: 2016 Field Office Visitor Counts
ssa-field-office-visitor-counts-2016.description: This file contains the number of people visit a Social Security Administration field office for FY 2016.

ssa-field-office-visitors.title: Field Office Visitors (Average Daily) - FY 2006 On
ssa-field-office-visitors.description: The average daily number of field office visitors is computed by dividing the number of visitors to SSA field offices by the number of days in the month.

ssa-hearing-office-workload.title: Hearing Office Workload Data - Current Report
ssa-hearing-office-workload.description: A presentation of four key workload indicators (pending, receipts, dispositions and average processing time) for each hearing office in the Office of Hearings Operations (OHO).

ssa-hearing-wait-time.title: Average Wait Time Until Hearing Held Report - Current Report
ssa-hearing-wait-time.description: A presentation of the average time (in months) from the hearing request date until a hearing is held for claims closed in the Office of Hearings Operations (OHO) hearing offices.

ssa-initial-disability-processing-time.title: Combined Title II Disability and Title XVI Blind and Disabled Average Processing Time - FY 2016 On
ssa-initial-disability-processing-time.description: The data contained in this dataset shows the overall cumulative number of elapsed days (including processing time for transit, technical determinations, medical determinations, and quality review) from the date of filing through the date payment is made or the denial notice is issued for all initial claims that require a medical determination for fiscal years 2016 on.

ssa-national-beneficiary-survey.title: National Beneficiary Survey: Disability Statistics (series)
ssa-national-beneficiary-survey.description: A publication providing key descriptive statistics from the National Beneficiary Survey, including beneficiary characteristics and health, program and service participation, employment interest and activity, job characteristics, and benefits and employment interaction.

ssa-nscf.title: National Survey of SSI Children and Families (NSCF)
ssa-nscf.description: The NSCF collected data on the health status and functional limitations, health care utilization, health insurance coverage, receipt of services, SSI experience, socioeconomic status of children's households, and housing characteristics of over 8,000 children who were receiving, had received, or were applying for SSI. The study is limited to the non-institutionalized population in the continental United States (i.e., it does not include residents of Alaska, Hawaii, and US territories). Data collection began in July 2001 and ended in July 2002.

ssa-oasdi-beneficiaries-by-state.title: OASDI Beneficiaries by State and County (series)
ssa-oasdi-beneficiaries-by-state.description: An annual publication providing statistics on the Social Security population at the local level. It contains tables on benefit type (retirement, survivors, and disability) and beneficiary category (retired and disabled workers, wives and husbands, widow(er)s, and children).

ssa-reconsideration-processing-time.title: Disability Reconsideration Average Processing Time (Excludes technical denials) - FY2014 On
ssa-reconsideration-processing-time.description: A presentation of the overall cumulative number of elapsed days (including processing time for transit, medical determinations, and SSA quality review) from the date of filing through the date payment is made or the denial notice is issued for all reconsideration claims that require a medical determination. The data includes annual processing time for fiscal years 2014 on.

ssa-ssi-recipients-by-state.title: SSI Recipients by State and County (series)
ssa-ssi-recipients-by-state.description: An annual statistical report on the Supplemental Security Income program that provides tables on program recipients, federal payments, and federally administered state supplementation.

ssa-state-agency-workload-data.title: SSA State Agency Workload Data
ssa-state-agency-workload-data.description: The dataset is revised and expanded from 4 to 71 data fields. It includes monthly data from October 2000 onwards for SSA disability cases that were referred to the state agency for a disability determination. When first released, initial claims information was available, but now new information is included on reconsideration and continuing disability review cases, with breakouts by claim title (SSDI, SSI) for each case type. Specific data elements for each state are receipts, end of month pending counts, decisions, and the number of decisions which were allowances.

ssa-ticket-to-work-fy11-17.title: Ticket to Work FY11-17
ssa-ticket-to-work-fy11-17.description: This file contains the Total Number of Tickets Assigned to Employment Networks for FY 2011-2017.

ssa-title2-claim-receipts-by-field-offic.title: 2016 Title 2 Claim Receipts by Field Office
ssa-title2-claim-receipts-by-field-offic.description: This file contains the number of Title 2 disability claims receipts by the field offices for FY 2016 (includes 53rd week).
